cgpa_simulator.desc: Exact-distribution semester CGPA simulator: set per-course grade probabilities, get expected CGPA, percentiles and P(target), computed by convolution over every grade path. React + Express.

OR2.desc: Multi-objective baggage packing optimiser comparing dynamic programming and integer programming (PuLP), with a Streamlit app. IIT Kharagpur IM21204 Operations Research II.

Competitive-Programming.desc: Accepted solutions from Codeforces and LeetCode, in C++ (and one in Python), indexed by problem.

Quantitative-Finance.desc: Streamlit app that pulls daily prices with yfinance and forecasts one to four years ahead with Prophet, with interactive Plotly charts.

Time-series-models.desc: ARIMA forecasting of the USD/INR exchange rate: ADF stationarity testing, ACF/PACF diagnostics, and rolling one-step evaluation.

Neural_Networks.desc: Dense neural network for MNIST digit classification in TensorFlow/Keras, from data pipeline to evaluation.

Regression-Models.desc: Linear regression (house prices) and logistic regression (Titanic) implemented from scratch in NumPy with hand-written gradient descent.

Classification_models.desc: Titanic survival prediction compared across logistic regression, naive Bayes, KNN, SVM, decision tree, random forest and XGBoost; plus an SVM baseline on Iris.

KDAG_Core_Tasks.desc: KDAG core selection tasks: Levenshtein-distance spelling correction for survey data, and k-means clustering written from scratch for night-time satellite imagery.

Business_Club_Tasks.desc: Business Club induction task: exploratory data analysis of the Chipotle orders dataset with pandas and NumPy.

Microsoft-project.desc: Yahoo Finance scraper in Python (requests + BeautifulSoup): live quotes, top gainers and losers, a CSV-backed portfolio tracker, and a headline fetcher.

Python-timepass.desc: Small Tkinter desktop toys built to pass time: a stopwatch and an image viewer.

Snake-Game.desc: Snake, twice: a terminal version with curses and a windowed version with pygame.
